text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. What types of vehicles should our system support?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system should be extensible to support different vehicle types such as bikes, cars, trucks, bus etc.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Can a parking spot accomodate any vehicle?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - No, each parking spot supports a specific vehicle type

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. How to calculate the prices for parking?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system should support multiple pricing strategies like:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Should system support multiple payment methods?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - yes, The system must be extensable to accommodate various payment methods

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: such as UPI/ Credit Card, Cash etc,.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. How many floors and parking spots can the parking lot have?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system should allow dynamic configuration of floors and slots per floor. Each slot must be mapped to a vehicle type

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. How many gates should our system support?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system should support multiple gates and exit gates

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A ticket should be generated at entry, containing vehicle details, entry timestamp, etc.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - At exit, this ticket will be used to calculate the final cost1. What types of vehicles should our system support?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system should be extensible to support different vehicle types such as bikes, cars, trucks, bus etc.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Are we building a system for just one physical parking lot or do we want to scale it to multiple lots in future?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Do we need to ensure that no two vehivles get the same parking spot?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, The system should use proper locking mechanism or synchronized access to parking slot assignment
